units.source_text: 仪仗队领头的是明治维新时期的勤王队、丹波北桑田的山国队，殿后的是延历时代的文官上朝场面的队伍。

en.t: At the head of the procession were the loyalist troops from the Meiji Restoration period and the Yamaguni troops from Kitakuwada in Tanba, while bringing up the rear was a formation representing civil officials going to court in the Enryaku era.

units.source_text: 仪仗队一回到平安神宫，就在凤辇 [5] 前致贺词。

en.t: As soon as the procession returned to Heian Shrine, congratulatory words were offered before the phoenix palanquin [5].
